summary: EPAM Systems filed an 8-K reporting Q3 2026 results and a board-approved increase in its buyback authorization. The Board raised the repurchase program to $1.8 billion, replacing the prior $1 billion authorization from October 2025, and the company plans to enter a $500 million accelerated share repurchase the following week, committing to return at least 50% of free cash flow to shareholders. Q3 revenue was $1.426 billion, up 2.3% year-over-year, with non-GAAP EPS of $3.51. Watch ASR execution pace and dilution offset.
